items.name: Cubing by the Kings OH 2025
items.information:
This competition takes place on **SUNDAY**. If you are interested in also participating in PBQ events, click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuietbytheKingsOH2025) to view the page for the Quiet by the Kings OH 2025 competition taking place on Saturday, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. 

If you are a first-time competitor, the [Registration Process and FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingbytheKingsOH2025#59516-registration-process-and-faq-for-new-competitors) tab has useful information how the competition will look. All competitiors must read the [Competitior Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingbytheKingsOH2025#59517-competitor-information-must-read) tab before registering.

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)

Cubing by the Kings OH 2025 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org)
